5.headline: AllBidness needed 28 points from a Jaguars quarterback on a Monday night. He got them.
paragraphs: Fourteen alive going into week 5 and for most of Sunday the axe had a name on it. **AllBidness** sat dead last after the early window at 40.5, was still last after the late window at 58.5, and went into Sunday night 22.28 points behind the next-worst team with three players still to play. Trevor Lawrence, Travis Kelce, and Bhayshul Tuten. Nobody in the league chat was betting on that group.

Then Monday happened. Lawrence dropped 28.24, Kelce added 19.1, Tuten chipped in 2.1 for a 49.44-point night that carried AllBidness from the chop seat to eighth place at 118.24. That is not surviving. That is getting shot at and having the bullet hit your phone.

Which meant the axe swung the other way. **Vanquished** had every player accounted for by Sunday night at 96.14 and could only watch, and **joefanelli90** lived by 4.64 with nothing left to play either, the fantasy equivalent of a death-row pardon by fax. At the top, **nelsolson** put up 147.86 on a 100.58 projection and takes the $25 for outscoring the corpse by 51.72. Thirteen left.
